protocol.T_method: translation-orbit span of every minimum-weight Z-logical modulo S_Z; every translate verified to lie in ker[A B]
protocol.d_Q_threshold_method: surviving minimum pure-Z logical, else exhaustive symplectic MITM over all ternary Pauli patterns of weight <= d_Z under per-side budget 20000000
protocol.d_Z_method: ascending-weight exact enumeration of ker[A B]: per split the cheaper side is enumerated and the other side solved over a coset of its kernel (GF(2) column solver); one-sided splits read the kernel spans directly; the EXP-041 MITM join is the fallback when neither solve orientation is feasible.  Both engines verified bit-exact on real parents (self_tests) and against full nullspace spans (span_cross_checks)
protocol.lattice_set: all ordered (ell, m) with ell, m >= 2 and ell*m <= 24 (37 shapes)
protocol.nondegenerate_predicate: k_P >= 2 and a single Tanner component
protocol.parent_equivalence: supports identified under independent Z_ell x Z_m translations of the A and B blocks; {A, B} unordered; k_P, d_Z, T are invariants of the class
protocol.perturbation_class: every literal [C D] support of total weight 1..3 with zero AC^T + BD^T commutation defect

verdict_detail: No parent with T < k_P/2 exists among the 4621 exhaustively enumerated connected k>=2 parents on any lattice with ell*m <= 24 (families 2x2, 2x3, 3x3); Conjecture B-prime's residual class is vacuous at small lattices.
